name: Perfect Awareness
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Perfect Awareness (Combat, Meditation)
Source Faiths and Philosophies pg. 19
You can set aside all irrelevant sensory information to understand your surroundings perfectly for a moment.

Prerequisites: Wis 17, Combat Meditation, Meditation Master, character level 9th.

Benefit: Once per day, you can take 20 on a Perception check as a move action.
